records.source_statement: Chapter LI begins below the printed horizontal divider following Chapter L.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: CHAP. LI. Of Battle, Warre, or other Contentions.

records.source_statement: The opening question is whether the querent will overcome an adversary.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: whether he shall overcome his Adversary or not

records.source_statement: Assign the ascendant lord, Moon, and planet Moon separated from to the querent in the opening contest method.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: give to the Querent the Lord of the ascendant the Moon and the Planet from whom she is separated
preconditions: In the opening adversary question, assign to querent: ascendant lord; Moon; and the planet FROM which Moon separated.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: These are source-defined roles, not verified outcomes.

records.source_statement: Assign seventh house, seventh lord, and planet to which the Moon applies to the defendant; sentence crosses printed pages 366–367.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: unto the Defendant, the seventh and his Lord, and the Planet to whom the Moon applyeth
preconditions: Assign to defendant: seventh house; seventh lord; and planet TO which Moon applies. Printed clause physically crosses original pages400→401.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not replace the planet Moon applies TO with the planet from which she separated.

records.source_statement: Compare the appointed significators' angular positions, dignity and association with more favorable planets before the author's judgment.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: behold whose Significator is in Angles and best and with better Planets
preconditions: Consider the respective significators' angular status, strength and companion planets before the outcome comparison.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: How to aggregate competing testimonies is not explicitly quantified.

records.source_statement: Unfortunate planets in the first with fortunate planets in the seventh are said to favor the opponent.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: If evill Planets be in the Ascendant, and Fortunes in the seventh, the Adversary shall overcome
preconditions: Unfortunate planet(s) in ASC AND fortunate planet(s) in seventh; outcome author attributes to adversary.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical judgment, not an observed outcome.

records.source_statement: The author adds a converse to the prior first-versus-seventh benefic/malefic example, attributing advantage to the querent under the reversed pattern.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: & e contra
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The converse is abbreviated; preserve its connection to the immediately preceding condition.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord placed in the ascendant is said to favor the querent.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: The Lord of the seventh in the Ascendant, betokens victory to the Querent
preconditions: Seventh house lord in ascendant; victory is ascribed to querent.

records.source_statement: A second abbreviated converse follows the seventh-lord-in-first statement; the exact inverse placement/consequence should not be treated as fully enumerated.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: & e contra
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not invent a precise equation from 'e contra' alone.

records.source_statement: New heading on return from war or dangerous voyage; distinct from defeating an adversary.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Whether one shall returne safe from Warre, or any dangerous Voyage

records.source_statement: Ascendant lord strong, favorably associated, and well disposed is called a testimony of secure return.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Lord of the Ascendant be strong, and with a good Planet, and well disposed
preconditions: Ascendant lord strong AND with a good planet AND well disposed; safe return authorial claim.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The conjunction of strength, benefic association and good disposition is explicit.

records.source_statement: A converse is given to the previous security testimony.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: & e contra
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Inverse is source shorthand and not a mechanically enumerated conjunction.

records.source_statement: Fortunate seventh house and seventh lord, despite an unfavorable first, are said to imply eventual return accompanied by significant losses and impediments.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: seventh and the Lord thereof, and if they be Fortunate (although the first be not so)
preconditions: Seventh house and its lord fortunate even when first is not; source claims eventual return WITH losses/obstacles.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Preserve safe return AND adverse losses together, not a blanket positive.

records.source_statement: The author adds a converse to the seventh-fortunate despite first-weak condition.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: & e contra
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The exact altered outcome and conjunction are not spelled out.

records.source_statement: Evaluate Moon's condition; application to a benefic is described as favorable.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Behold also the Moon how she is disposed; for her application with the good is Fortunate
preconditions: Moon applies to a good planet; Moon's own condition must also be observed.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon's aspect/application must not be silently replaced by her house placement.

records.source_statement: An unfavorable converse is added to the Moon-application testimony.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: & e contra
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No exact degree/orb threshold provided.

records.source_statement: Malefics in the eighth are presented as an indication of fear, terror or death.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Evill Planets also in the eight, are no small Signification of feare, and terrour, or death
preconditions: Malefic planet(s) in eighth; adverse alternatives fear/terror/death.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The alternatives are not all unavoidable outcomes; no factual injury-risk prediction is validated.

records.source_statement: Differentiate source symbolism: Saturn—ruins/bruises; Mars or the South Node—weapon wounds.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Saturn signifies ruines or bruises, Mars or the Dragon's Tail wounds by Weapons
preconditions: Saturn category=bruises/ruins; Mars OR printed node-like glyph category=weapon wounds.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Planetary glyphs in print control; do not transform into medical advice.

records.source_statement: Second safe-return subsection heading; do not merge with previous dangerous-voyage paragraph.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: If one shall returne safe from Warre

records.source_statement: Ascendant lord associated with a benefic, itself fortunate, OR a benefic in first are alternative indicators of safe return.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Lord of the Ascendant be with good or good himself, or a good Planet in the Ascendant
preconditions: First lord with a good planet OR itself good OR benefic planet in first; any one is printed as a safe-return testimony.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original 'or' conditions are alternatives, not three jointly required conditions.

records.source_statement: Sun conjunct the ascendant lord anywhere in the question is given as a warning against departure, attributed to combustion.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: if the Sun be with the Lord of the Ascendant ... he may not goe; because the Sun burns him
preconditions: Sun with ascendant lord at any part of the chart; source advises no departure and attributes this to burning.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Contrasts with blanket Sun-as-benefic interpretation; no modern safety claim.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord with benefic AND first lord with malefic is said to yield impediment but not death.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Lord of the seventh be with a good Planet, and the Lord of the Ascendant with an evill
preconditions: Seventh lord with benefic AND ascendant lord with malefic; source says impediment yet no death.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Both sides' relations are conjunctive; the outcome contains an explicit no-death exception.

records.source_statement: Malefic with first lord AND benefic in first is said to yield loss, wounding, yet not death.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: evill Planet be with the Lord of the first, and a good one in the first
preconditions: Malefic with first lord AND benefic in first; source predicts loss/wounds but explicitly excludes death.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Losses, injury and explicit no-death clause must all be kept.

records.source_statement: Saturn in first OR with first lord is given as advice against going, linked to loss from someone encountered.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: If Saturn be in the first, or with the Lord of the first, let him not goe
preconditions: Saturn in first OR with first lord; the author advises against travel.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The alternative Saturn placements are not a joint requirement.

records.source_statement: Malefic with first lord AND Saturn in ascendant or with its lord is said to produce wounding by wood or stone; 'or Stone' continues p368.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: if an ill Planet be with the Lord of the first, and Saturn in the Ascendant ... wounded with Wood or Stone
preconditions: Malefic with first lord AND Saturn in first OR Saturn with first lord (grouping requires care); original wood/stone consequence crosses PDF401→402.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Keep original conjunctive/alternative syntax; this is historical not clinical evidence.

records.source_statement: Mars or South Node in first/with first lord OR malefics first/with lord is said to cause a grievous wound near death.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: If Mars or the Dragon's Tail be in the Ascendant, or with the Lord thereof, or evill Planets in the first
preconditions: Mars OR South Node in first or with first lord; OR malefics in first or with lord. Clause contains alternative groups, not necessarily all required.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original grammar contains ORs; do not assume every listed placement is required.

records.source_statement: Malefic in eighth is a separate historical death-warning testimony.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: if an evill Planet be in the eight, it is to be feared, death will ensue
preconditions: Malefic planet in eighth; author raises death as feared outcome.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not empirically predictive of actual risk of death.

records.source_statement: Sun with seventh lord OR in eighth is offered as warning against the journey; source adds elliptical 'and so of the tenth and seventh'.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: if the Sun be with the Lord of the seventh, or in the eight, it is ill to goe
preconditions: Sun with seventh lord OR Sun in eighth; terminal 'so of tenth and seventh' remains ambiguous.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not construct precise additional pairs or aspects from the unfinished/elliptical tail.

records.source_statement: New heading introducing two-sided war outcomes, distinct from return-from-war safety.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: What will ensue of the Warre

records.source_statement: For this war-outcome subsection, identify the first house/first lord with querent and seventh/seventh lord with opponent.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: the first House signifieth the Querent, the seventh his Adversary
preconditions: First house/lord denote querent; seventh house/lord denote opposing party in this subsection.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Contextual assignments are local to the printed method.

records.source_statement: Benefics in first AND malefics in seventh AND strong first lord/weak seventh lord are said to favor querent.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: good Planets be in the first, and malevolent in the seventh, and Lord of the Ascendant good
preconditions: Good planets in first AND evil in seventh AND first lord well conditioned AND seventh lord ill.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not simplify to benefic-first placement alone.

records.source_statement: A separately specified converse with malefic associated with first lord, malefic in first, and well-conditioned seventh lord/benefic in seventh is said to defeat the querent, possibly capture or death.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Infortune be with the Lord of the Ascendant, and an evill Planet in the Ascendant, and the Lord of the seventh good
preconditions: Malefic with ascendant lord AND malefic in first AND seventh lord well conditioned AND benefic in seventh.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original includes multiple AND terms; this is a claimed historical result not a medical or legal forecast.

records.source_statement: Both first/seventh lords in first, plus benefics aspecting the second-house CUSP, are claimed to favor the querent and financial gain.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: both the Lords of the Ascendant and seventh be in the Ascendant ... good Planets casting benevolent aspects to the cuspe of the second
preconditions: First AND seventh lords in ascendant; benefics casting benevolent aspects to SECOND-HOUSE CUSP, on the ascendant lord's behalf.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Second cusp is the object, not necessarily second ruler. The 'on behalf of first lord' condition remains attached.

records.source_statement: Under the preceding compound first-house/second-cusp conditions, the author presents victory OR reconciliation as outcomes; do not treat them as simultaneously guaranteed.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: he shall have victory ... or they will endeavour to be reconciled
preconditions: Inherits preceding both-lords-ASC and benefic-to-second-cusp conditions; outcomes victory OR potential reconciliation.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Same condition as previous record, not an independent new chart test.

records.source_statement: Both house lords in first AND benefics on querent side/malefics on seventh side are said to yield loss for both, with querent better in the end.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: both the Lords, viz. of the first and seventh, be in the Ascendant, and good Planets be on the part of the Ascendant, and evil on the part of the seventh
preconditions: Both first and seventh lords in ASC; benefics on ascendant side and malefics on seventh side; both suffer, querent better at end.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not omit both-sides-loss qualification.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in first is again linked to the fortune of the actors in this war-outcome context.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: If the Lord of the seventh be in the Ascendant ... it shewes the Fortune of the Actors
preconditions: Seventh lord in ASC in war-outcome subsection; 'fortune of Actors' referent unresolved.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Author's referent 'Actors' is not independently defined beyond this paragraph.

records.source_statement: The prior seventh-lord-in-first clause is followed by the distinct printed phrase 'the contrary noteth the contrary'; detailed inverse placements are not enumerated.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: the contrary noteth the contrary
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Exact reverse configuration and opponent result not specified; do not make it a precise executable rule.

records.source_statement: Printed marginal grouping assigns planets in houses 10,11,12,1,2,3 to the querent's side.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Any Planet in the 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3 is conceived a friend to the Querent
preconditions: Printed margin classes houses 10/11/12/1/2/3 as querent's party.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is an original margin note, not a modern astrological generalization.

records.source_statement: Printed marginal grouping assigns planets in houses 9,8,7,6,5,4 to the quesited/opponent's side.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: all Planets in the 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4 are reputed for the Quesited
preconditions: Printed margin classes houses 9/8/7/6/5/4 as quesited's party.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Retain complementarity and original printed margin status.

records.source_statement: First lord in eighth OR with eighth lord OR eighth lord in first is said to signify death of querent.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Lord of the Ascendant be in the eight, or with the Lord of the eight, or the Lord of the eight in the Ascendant
preconditions: First lord in eighth OR first lord conjoined with eighth lord OR eighth lord in first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Multiple alternatives; unsupported as a real mortality predictor.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in second OR with second lord OR second lord in seventh/with seventh lord is said to signify death of adversary.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: Lord of the seventh be in the second, or with the Lord thereof, or the Lord of the second in the seventh
preconditions: Seventh lord in second OR with second lord OR second lord in seventh OR with seventh lord.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not leave off the last 'with the Lord of the seventh' alternative.

records.source_statement: Chapter LII begins at the top of original PDF403/printed369; no Chapter LII body is included as a Chapter LI source rule.
records.original_source_anchor_editorial_normali: CHAP. LII. Who shall doe best in a suit of Law.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Navigation-only boundary, not an accepted substantive result.
